name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.0-dev.44 (19 Nov): China tank and AT balance (front HEAT armour capped at 1200, armour-kit side HEAT lowered, sabots 10, RPGs 10, ZTZ-99A/ZTZ-100 armour, China optics raised to US/RU), China AT launchers like vanilla, open-ground infantry protection off, autocannon and China tank HE Ignore Cover 0.25, passengers die with their transport, contested zones neutralise on every map, HHQ-10 like the MML, new start screen art, trimmed victory/defeat music, FAModels frees unused models. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.47.
